selection.rationale: With no prior strategy-local outcomes in this initial round, we allocate the 64-structure budget evenly across all four fcc_cantor compositions (16 each for equiatomic CrMnFeCoNi and off-stoichiometric Cr2MnFeCoNi, CrMn2FeCoNi, and CrMnFe2CoNi) and span all perturbation modes (chemical disorder, substitutional ordering, and 0.02 bounded strain). Every size tier requirement is satisfied (4, 8, 16, 20, and 16 structures for tiers 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64 respectively), weighting larger supercells more heavily so five-element chemical stoichiometry and configurational diversity are well resolved without early symmetry deduplication bottlenecks.
